key.name: reminder-enabled
key.description: Open the popup automatically on an interval, but only when there are unfinished tasks.

key.name: reminder-skip-fullscreen
key.summary: Do not pop up over fullscreen apps

key.name: reminder-autoclose
key.summary: Auto-hide a reminder popup after this many seconds if untouched (0 keeps it open)

key.name: reminder-preview
key.summary: Internal: bumped by the preferences window to preview a reminder

key.name: accent
key.summary: Accent colour ("system" follows the desktop accent)

key.name: theme
key.summary: Light or dark popup ("system" follows the desktop style)

key.name: show-badge
key.summary: Show the number of open tasks in the top bar

key.name: completed-to-bottom
key.summary: Move completed tasks to the bottom of the list

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the popup
